evals.prompt: cross-post this to LinkedIn, X, and Instagram: we open-sourced our internal design system today
evals.expected_output: One native-feeling draft per requested platform, each adapted in tone/length/format, with a one-line note on what changed for that platform.
assertions: Produces a distinct draft for LinkedIn, X, and Instagram
Each draft respects that platform's length and format norms
Each draft includes a one-line note on what was adapted and why
Drafts are not identical copy-paste across platforms

evals.prompt: post this everywhere: blog post announcing our Series A [link]
evals.expected_output: Native drafts across the user's default platforms, handling the link per each platform's convention (e.g. first comment on LinkedIn).
assertions: Link placement follows each platform's convention
Each draft stands alone without referencing the other platforms
